overview: Career City is a retro RPG town for job seekers, inspired by Zelda and Pokemon. Explore a pixel-art top-down town, enter career tool buildings to build resumes and prep for interviews, talk to NPCs with dry humor, earn XP and level up from Intern to CTO, and save your progress with Internet Identity login.
features: Phaser 3 pixel-art town map with Ansimuz animated tilesets
Four career tool buildings: Resume Tailor, Cover Letter Generator, Interview Coach, Item Shop
Per-location music with smooth Zelda/Pokemon-style fade transitions
Pokemon-style NPCs with quests and dry self-aware humor
XP and Career Level system (Intern to CTO)
Minimizable minimap with fast-travel including Town Square
WCAG/Section 508 compliant text (18px minimum, high contrast)
Internet Identity login with backend save state
